newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swede threatened to kill with pet snake - paper.
newsitem.headline: Swede threatened to kill with pet snake - paper.

text.p: A Swedish man was arrested after he threatened to kill his neighbour with his pet poisonous snake following a row, a Swedish newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The 32-year-old man from Filipstad in central Sweden was visiting his neighbour, when the two men started arguing, according to Swedish tabloid Expressen.
He slipped out for a moment and returned with his pet venomous snake under his jacket which he proceeded to wave in his opponent's face, threatening to kill him.
The snake owner was arrested after his neighbour called the police and the snake was taken to a nearby zoo. Police said he was the first person in Sweden to be arrested for using a snake as a weapon.
